population.method: sum of WorldPop 1km pixel population counts whose center lies within each grid cell; approximate at 1km resolution

upstream_area_ha.method: max pixel value for upstream hectares, modal valid D8 direction for direction; 15 arcsecond source pixels

flow_direction_d8.method: max pixel value for upstream hectares, modal valid D8 direction for direction; 15 arcsecond source pixels

flood_observations.instruction: Download UNOSAT product 3342/3348 SHP to data/raw/historical_flood/unosat, inspect archive, rerun with --flood-vector and --assessed-vector (only if actual footprint source exists). Do not infer footprint from flood extent.

vulnerability.event_conditioned: August 2022 rainfall is an explanatory input: NOT a forecast

validation.reason: Need actual flood extent plus independently documented satellite assessed-area footprint and both flooded/unflooded observed cells

agriculture.reason: No verified land-use/cropland raster supplied. Do not invent agricultural land impact. Accept verified class map in a future integration.

impact.warning: Population*inundated-area ratio assumes uniform population density within each 5km cell; not confirmed affected people.
